fields.ic_name: AMBA AXI / ACE Protocol Specification (ARM IHI 0022E)
typical_topologies_inherited: Shared address buses and multiple data buses
Multilayer, with multiple address and data buses
ace_specific_topology_components: Point of Serialization (POS) — system-level cache controller or coherency manager; orders all coherent operations to a given address.
Point of Coherency (PoC) — for Non-shareable accesses, the location of the master copy.
Snoop Filter (optional) — tracks which masters cache which addresses to suppress unnecessary snoops; relies on accurate Evict / WriteEvict notifications.
Cached Master Port — full ACE port with AR/R/AW/W/B + AC/CR/CD + RACK/WACK + AxDOMAIN/AxSNOOP/AxBAR + extended RRESP/BRESP.
ACE-Lite Master Port — same as cached, minus AC/CR/CD channels.
Snoop Distributor — interconnect block that, on receipt of a coherent AR/AW, generates AC snoops to all relevant cached masters in the named shareability domain.
DVM Distributor — propagates DVMMessage / DVMComplete on the AC channels of all DVM-capable masters in the named domain.
interconnect_role_in_ace_summary: Decode (AxDOMAIN + AxSNOOP + AxBAR + AxADDR) -> determine snoop list.
Issue AC snoops to all masters in the named shareability domain (excluding the initiator).
Collect CR responses (and CD data when DataTransfer=1) per snoop.
Aggregate snoop results — choose dirty data source, compute final RRESP[3:2] / BRESP[2].
Forward the response on R (or B) to the initiator.
Wait for RACK / WACK from the initiator before issuing snoops that depend on this transaction's coherency state.
Handle barrier transactions — block ordering across the barrier within the named domain.
Distribute DVM messages — broadcast on AC to all DVM-capable masters in the domain; aggregate CR; emit DVMComplete.
fields.id_handling_inherited: Inherited from AXI4: interconnect appends master-port bits to AxID for routing; strips on response. RACK/WACK serve as response-delivery acknowledge.
interconnect_ordering_requirements_ace: Inherited AXI same-ID ordering applies (request and response order).
Snoop ordering: CR responses on a given master follow the AC address order on that master.
RACK / WACK gating: interconnect must observe RACK/WACK before issuing dependent snoops.
Barriers (Memory or Synchronization, AxBAR=01/11): block reordering across the barrier within the named domain.
DVM ordering: DVMMessage broadcasts must be acknowledged by all targets in the domain before DVMComplete is issued.

default_signal_values_for_ace_additions.ARDOMAIN_default_for_legacy_axi_masters: 0b00 (Non-shareable) — AXI4-only masters on ACE interconnect are treated as Non-shareable.
default_signal_values_for_ace_additions.RACK_WACK_for_axi_only_masters: Tie LOW or omit; ACE interconnect may auto-ack.

snoop_filter_optional_requirements.purpose: Reduce snoop traffic by tracking shareable cache-line allocation per master.
required_notifications: Evict (AWSNOOP=0b100) when a master removes an Inner/Outer Shareable clean line.
WriteEvict (AWSNOOP=0b101 + AWUNIQUE=1) when a master removes a UniqueClean line (snoop-filter-tracked).
WriteBack/WriteClean must carry correct AWDOMAIN so the snoop filter can update.
snoop_filter_optional_requirements.without_snoop_filter: Interconnect must broadcast every snoop to every coherent master; no Evict required for Non-shareable lines either way.

memory_vs_peripheral_regions_inherited.Memory_location: Read returns last value written; write updates value; accesses no side-effects on other Memory locations.
memory_vs_peripheral_regions_inherited.Peripheral_region: Implementation-defined access method; non-conforming access must complete protocol-compliantly but functional behavior not guaranteed.

barrier_scope_by_domain.Non_shareable_barrier: Orders only within the initiator's Non-shareable domain (effectively only that master).
barrier_scope_by_domain.Inner_Shareable_barrier: Orders within all masters in the Inner-shareable domain.
barrier_scope_by_domain.Outer_Shareable_barrier: Orders within Outer-shareable domain (superset of Inner).
barrier_scope_by_domain.System_barrier: Orders across all masters in the system (strongest).

dvm_distribution_rules: DVMMessage broadcast on AC of all DVM-capable masters in the named shareability domain.
Each DVM target invalidates the indicated entry and acknowledges on CR.
DVMComplete is issued after all targets have acked — interconnect aggregates and signals 'sync done'.
DVMComplete uses ARSNOOP=0b1110; DVMMessage uses ARSNOOP=0b1111.

evidence.spec_section: A1.2.2 Interface and interconnect / Typical system topologies
evidence.quote: Most systems use one of three interconnect topologies: shared address and data buses; shared address buses and multiple data buses; multilayer, with multiple address and data buses.
The ACE protocol provides hardware cache coherency support and is an extension of the AXI4 protocol.
A shareability domain is a set of masters. The ACE protocol specifies four levels of shareability domain: Non-shareable, Inner Shareable, Outer Shareable, System.
All snoop transactions are ordered. A response on the snoop response channel must be in the same order as the addresses on the snoop address channel.
A barrier transaction can have any shareability domain, and the choice of domain is used to determine the precise behavior of the barrier with respect to other masters in the system.

DVMMessage and DVMComplete encodings on ARSNOOP enable distribution of TLB invalidate, branch predictor invalidate, instruction cache invalidate, and virtual address synchronization across coherent masters.
